snippet.title: Radica Tank Assault
snippet.description:
This is the LCD game "Tank Assault" by Radica which is quite a good adaptation of the vector arcade game Battlezone by Atari. 

Video was recorded on November 20, 2016 with a Samsung S4 phone.
